description: Evals for /eas-prebuild-check — validates Expo iOS/Android sync before first EAS build

cases.name: missing-easignore-detected
cases.description: Project with no .easignore should fail check 01 loudly
cases.prompt: /eas-prebuild-check (in a project with no .easignore and a 500MB node_modules)

assertions.name: check-01-fail
assertions.description: Output contains '[1/9]' line with '✗ FAIL' status and references '.easignore'

assertions.name: fix-suggested
assertions.description: Output suggests --fix or copying from templates/.easignore

assertions.name: do-not-build-warning
assertions.description: Output contains 'DO NOT run `eas build`' in summary section

cases.name: easignore-partial-warn
cases.description: .easignore exists but missing node_modules → WARN not FAIL

assertions.name: check-01-warn
assertions.description: Output shows check 1 as '⚠ WARN' (not FAIL)

assertions.name: missing-node-modules-listed
assertions.description: Output names 'node_modules' in the missing excludes list

cases.name: bundle-id-suspicious-default
cases.description: Suspicious scaffold bundle IDs (com.yuvalnir.fromtoday, com.anonymous.*) flagged as WARN

assertions.name: check-04-warn
assertions.description: Output shows check 4 (Bundle ID consistency) as WARN

assertions.name: suspicious-label
assertions.description: Output contains 'suspicious' or 'scaffold default' language

assertions.name: fix-references-app-json
assertions.description: Fix suggestion mentions editing app.json expo.ios.bundleIdentifier

cases.name: version-mismatch-detected
cases.description: Missing versionCode or buildNumber should FAIL check 05
cases.prompt: /eas-prebuild-check --platform both (app.json has version but no buildNumber/versionCode)

assertions.name: check-05-fail
assertions.description: Check 5 (Version sync) shows FAIL

assertions.name: missing-fields-listed
assertions.description: Output explicitly names the missing fields (ios.buildNumber or android.versionCode)

cases.name: no-ios-devices-preview
cases.description: Preview profile with 0 registered devices → FAIL check 06

assertions.name: check-06-fail
assertions.description: Check 6 (iOS devices registered) shows FAIL

assertions.name: device-create-suggested
assertions.description: Fix suggestion is 'eas device:create'

cases.name: production-profile-skips-device-check
cases.description: Profile=production should SKIP check 06 (production uses App Store distribution, not ad-hoc)

assertions.name: check-06-skipped
assertions.description: Check 6 shows '⊘ SKIPPED' status with reason mentioning 'ad-hoc not required'

assertions.name: no-device-failure
assertions.description: Check 6 is NOT marked FAIL

cases.name: eas-cli-outdated-warn
cases.description: When local eas-cli is older than npm latest, check 3 should WARN

assertions.name: check-03-warn
assertions.description: Check 3 shows WARN status

assertions.name: upgrade-command
assertions.description: Fix suggests 'npm install -g eas-cli@latest'

cases.name: fix-writes-canonical-easignore
cases.description: --fix mode on project with no .easignore should write from template without data loss

assertions.name: check-01-pass-after-fix
assertions.description: After --fix, check 1 shows PASS

assertions.name: easignore-file-written
assertions.description: A .easignore file exists in the project after running and contains 'node_modules'

assertions.name: no-other-files-touched
assertions.description: No other files in the project were modified or created (except .easignore)

cases.name: fix-refuses-destructive-changes
cases.description: --fix should NEVER auto-change bundle ID, device registration, or credentials
cases.prompt: /eas-prebuild-check --fix (project has suspicious bundle ID and 0 devices)

assertions.name: no-auto-bundle-change
assertions.description: app.json bundleIdentifier is UNCHANGED after --fix

assertions.name: user-judgment-required
assertions.description: Output says check 4 still requires user action / 'needs user judgment' or similar

cases.name: json-mode-machine-readable
cases.description: --json flag produces valid parseable JSON with expected keys

assertions.name: valid-json
assertions.description: Output parses as valid JSON (jq . succeeds)

assertions.name: has-checks-array
assertions.description: JSON has 'checks' array with at least 9 entries

assertions.name: has-summary-object
assertions.description: JSON has 'summary' object with pass, fail, warn, skip, info counts

cases.name: managed-workflow-skip-native-checks
cases.description: Managed workflow (no ios/ or android/ dirs) — some native checks should SKIP or adapt
cases.prompt: /eas-prebuild-check (project has no ios/ or android/ folders — managed workflow)

assertions.name: still-runs-all-checks
assertions.description: All 9 checks still run (managed workflow still needs them)

assertions.name: easignore-still-important
assertions.description: Check 1 still runs — .easignore matters even in managed workflow (root node_modules exists)

cases.name: exit-code-nonzero-on-fail
cases.description: When any check is FAIL, exit code must be 1

assertions.name: exit-code-1
assertions.description: Shell exit code is 1 (not 0, not 2)

cases.name: exit-code-zero-on-pass
cases.description: When all checks are PASS or WARN/INFO only, exit code is 0

assertions.name: exit-code-0
assertions.description: Shell exit code is 0

cases.name: exit-code-2-not-expo
cases.description: Running outside an Expo project → exit 2 with clear message

assertions.name: not-expo-message
assertions.description: stderr says 'Not an Expo project' or mentions missing app.json/app.config.js

assertions.name: exit-code-2
assertions.description: Shell exit code is 2

notes: Baseline should be near zero because no agent naturally knows all 9 checks from memory — they require running specific eas-cli commands and parsing outputs.
Core discriminators: cases 1, 5, 7, 10 — these test the skill's unique knowledge.
Cases 8, 9 validate safety of --fix mode — critical for trust.
Cases 12-14 validate exit code discipline — required for CI/CD integration.
